description: CDK infrastructure: DynamoDB tables, S3 buckets, Lambda functions, API Gateway, Cognito, Step Functions state machines (content generation with parallel Marp+Polly, and render pipeline), and Hyperframes CDK Construct integration
steps: In infra/lib/storage-stack.ts, define: S3 project bucket ({productSlug}-projects-{env}-{accountId}-{region}) with Block Public Access, AES256 encryption, lifecycle rules (7 days for intermediate chunks, retain approved content). DynamoDB tables: Projects (PK: userId, SK: projectId), Versions (PK: projectId, SK: version), Jobs (PK: jobId), Idempotency (PK: idempotencyKey, TTL: 24h).
In infra/lib/auth-stack.ts, define: Cognito User Pool with email sign-in, User Pool Client for web app, configure JWT token generation.

In infra/lib/api-stack.ts, define: API Gateway REST API with Cognito authorizer, routes matching design section 15 (POST /v1/projects, POST /v1/projects/{id}/slides, GET /v1/projects/{id}/versions/{version}, POST /v1/projects/{id}/versions/{version}/approve, POST /v1/projects/{id}/videos, GET /v1/jobs/{jobId}, GET /v1/projects/{id}/deliverables). Lambda function for API handlers with minimal IAM (DynamoDB CRUD on own tables, S3 read on project bucket, StepFunctions:StartExecution).

In infra/lib/marp-lambda-stack.ts, define: Container image Lambda function for Marp rendering (DockerImageFunction). Memory 3008MB, ephemeral storage 2048MB, timeout 5 min. IAM: S3 write to project bucket slides/ and versions/ prefixes. Reference Dockerfile in lambdas/marp-render/.
In infra/lib/polly-worker-stack.ts, define: Lambda function for Polly worker. Memory 512MB, timeout 60s. IAM: polly:SynthesizeSpeech, S3 write to project bucket audio/ prefix.

In infra/lib/composition-builder-stack.ts, define: Lambda function for composition builder. Memory 512MB, timeout 60s. IAM: S3 read (manifest, images) and S3 write (composition HTML) on project bucket.

In infra/lib/content-state-machine.ts, define Step Functions Standard state machine for content generation: (1) Invoke Bedrock for Marp generation (placeholder Task state), (2) Save deck.md to S3, (3) Wait for approval (callback pattern or separate trigger), (4) Parallel branch: [Branch A: Invoke Marp Lambda for PDF/PPTX/PNG] [Branch B: Map over slides -> Invoke Polly Worker Lambda for each slide], (5) After parallel: Invoke timing resolver Lambda, (6) Invoke caption generator Lambda, (7) Invoke composition builder Lambda, (8) Start Render State Machine. Include error handling with retries on transient failures.

In infra/lib/render-state-machine.ts, define Step Functions Standard state machine for the render pipeline following the VideoRenderer port: (1) Invoke render Lambda with Action=plan, (2) Map state over chunks -> Invoke render Lambda with Action=renderChunk (parallel), (3) Invoke render Lambda with Action=assemble. Memory 10240MB, ephemeral storage 4096MB, timeout 15 min for render Lambda.
In infra/lib/delivery-stack.ts, define: CloudFront distribution with OAC for S3 origin (project bucket output/ prefix), signed URL support.

Write CDK assertion tests in infra/test/: verify S3 bucket has Block Public Access, verify DynamoDB tables have correct keys, verify Lambda functions have correct memory/timeout settings, verify Step Functions state machine definition structure, verify API Gateway routes exist with Cognito authorizer, verify IAM policies follow least privilege.
acceptance_criteria: CDK synth succeeds without errors (npx cdk synth)
S3 bucket is configured with Block Public Access and lifecycle rules
DynamoDB tables have correct partition and sort keys
API Gateway has all 7 routes with Cognito authorizer
Marp Lambda is DockerImageFunction with 3008MB memory and 2048MB ephemeral storage
Polly Worker Lambda has polly:SynthesizeSpeech permission
Content State Machine has Parallel state for Marp + Polly execution
Render State Machine has Map state for parallel chunk rendering
CloudFront distribution uses OAC for S3 access
CDK assertion tests pass confirming resource properties
productSlug is read from CDK context throughout all resource naming
verification: Run pnpm build to confirm CDK TypeScript compiles
Run pnpm test to confirm CDK assertion tests pass
Run npx cdk synth --context productSlug=testapp --context env=dev in infra/ to confirm CloudFormation template generation succeeds
findings: 1. CDK Stack class has a built-in 'environment' property (returns aws://account/region string), so custom props must use a different name (envName) to avoid collision. 2. cdk.json updated to use compiled dist output (node dist/bin/app.js) instead of ts-node for reliability. 3. Added type:module to infra/package.json for ESM support. 4. vitest.config.ts must exclude cdk.out/ directory since CDK synth copies Lambda assets there which may contain test files. 5. CDK synth validates successfully, confirming all CloudFormation resources are well-formed. 6. All 209 tests pass across the workspace (27 CDK assertion tests added).
